title: Neutral Advisor
subtitle: Tell me what you need in your own words and I'll recommend the best fit — with a deterministic engine that ranks by suitability and total cost, never commission.
neutralityNote: Ranking is fully neutral — commercial interest never enters the ranking.
placeholder: e.g. a quiet, energy-saving AC for a 30 m² room under 4000 SAR
noResultsTitle: No verified products for this category yet
noResultsBody: We add categories only when real, trustworthy data exists — we never fabricate results. Try another category or wording.
notSupportedTitle: No specialized advisor for this category yet
notSupportedBody: We show the best trustworthy prices without a specialized pick — we never fabricate a rating we can't evidence.
errorBody: Describe the product you want clearly — e.g. "a gaming laptop under 5000" or "a large family dishwasher".
addRoomSize: Add the room size (in m²) so I can size the capacity precisely.
measuredExitNote: Prices are updated from stores; tapping takes you straight to the store.
